evidence.notes: DeployCallback is a user-implemented callback contract; local deployment callback invocation remains unsupported separately.
Metadata subclasses use the generic Object clone path while preserving base Metadata fields.
DeployStatus mixed-case enum rows materialize as deterministic local enum values.
DeployStatus InProgress is available alongside the older IN_PROGRESS spelling.
MetadataType Layout is available as a shape enum for retrieve/service contracts.
MetadataType OmniInteractionAccessConfig is available as a shape enum for observed project contracts.

private class MetadataCallbackProbe implements Metadata.DeployCallback { public void handleResult(Metadata.DeployResult result, Metadata.DeployCallbackContext context) { String jobId = context == null ? null : context.getCallbackJobId(); System.assert(result == null || jobId == null || result.id != null); } }
@isTest private class MetadataDtoServiceContractsTest { @isTest static void metadataDtoShapeCompilesAndRuns() { Metadata.DeployCallback callback = new MetadataCallbackProbe(); callback.handleResult(new Metadata.DeployResult(), new Metadata.DeployCallbackContext()); Metadata.CustomMetadata custom = new Metadata.CustomMetadata(); custom.fullName = 'Feature.Default'; Metadata.Metadata base = custom; Metadata.Metadata cloned = (Metadata.Metadata)base.clone(); System.assertEquals('Feature.Default', cloned.fullName); Metadata.DeployResult result = new Metadata.DeployResult(); result.status = Metadata.DeployStatus.Canceled; System.assertEquals(Metadata.DeployStatus.Canceled, result.status); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.Canceling != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.Failed != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.InProgress != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.Pending != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.Succeeded != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.SucceededPartial != null); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.values().size() >= 6); Metadata.MetadataType customType = Metadata.MetadataType.CustomMetadata; Metadata.MetadataType layoutType = Metadata.MetadataType.Layout; Metadata.MetadataType omniType = Metadata.MetadataType.OmniInteractionAccessConfig; System.assert(customType != null); System.assert(layoutType != null); System.assert(omniType != null); } }
